name: Glenn C. Forester
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Cox Family Tree" (tree 17224056)
notes: Son of Charles Elmer and Etta (Burch) Forester. Born 15 Mar 1897 at Maplecrest, Williams County, Ohio; died 1 Dec 1965 at Hillsdale, Michigan; buried at Montgomery, Hillsdale County. He married Ruth Trilby Borton on 3 Nov 1917 at Jackson, Michigan (daughters Betty Joyce and Dorothy Jean), and after 1959 Helen Morrison Rowley.
